./skills/engineering/ask-matt.name: ask-matt
./skills/engineering/ask-matt.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

./skills/engineering/code-review.name: code-review
./skills/engineering/code-review.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/PRD asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

./skills/engineering/codebase-design.name: codebase-design
./skills/engineering/codebase-design.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

./skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs.name: diagnosing-bugs
./skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

./skills/engineering/domain-modeling.name: domain-modeling
./skills/engineering/domain-modeling.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.

./skills/engineering/grill-with-docs.name: grill-with-docs
./skills/engineering/grill-with-docs.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

./skills/engineering/implement.name: implement
./skills/engineering/implement.description: Implement a piece of work based on a PRD or set of issues.

./skills/engineering/improve-codebase-ar.name: improve-codebase-architecture
./skills/engineering/improve-codebase-ar.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

./skills/engineering/prototype.name: prototype
./skills/engineering/prototype.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

./skills/engineering/resolving-merge-con.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
./skills/engineering/resolving-merge-con.description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

./skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-s.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
./skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-s.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills — set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

./skills/engineering/tdd.name: tdd
./skills/engineering/tdd.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

./skills/engineering/to-issues.name: to-issues
./skills/engineering/to-issues.description: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices.

./skills/engineering/to-prd.name: to-prd
./skills/engineering/to-prd.description: Turn the current conversation into a PRD and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

./skills/engineering/triage.name: triage
./skills/engineering/triage.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

./skills/in-progress/claude-handoff.name: claude-handoff
./skills/in-progress/claude-handoff.description: Hand the current conversation off to a fresh background agent that picks up the work immediately.

./skills/in-progress/loop-me.name: loop-me
./skills/in-progress/loop-me.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.

./skills/in-progress/wayfinder.name: wayfinder
./skills/in-progress/wayfinder.description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of investigation tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the goal is clear.

./skills/in-progress/wizard.name: wizard
./skills/in-progress/wizard.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through a manual procedure — third-party setup, a one-off migration, an A→B state transition — opening URLs, capturing values, confirming each step, and writing .env files and GitHub Actions secrets.

./skills/productivity/handoff.name: handoff
./skills/productivity/handoff.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

./skills/productivity/teach.name: teach
./skills/productivity/teach.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

./skills/productivity/writing-great-skil.name: writing-great-skills
./skills/productivity/writing-great-skil.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable.
